# XO Rig - Custom PCs Built for Your Intent
> XO Rig is a custom PC building company based in India that builds PCs tailored to specific use cases (intents) rather than generic specifications. We focus on what you do, not just what specs you want. Pan-India delivery with 60-minute response time during business hours.

## Build Tiers
- **XO Spark**: Entry level builds (₹35,000 - ₹45,000)
- **XO Pulse**: Mid-range builds (₹55,000 - ₹95,000)
- **XO Nova**: High performance builds (₹1,10,000 - ₹1,85,000)
- **XO Apex**: Premium builds (₹2,20,000 - ₹2,75,000)
